anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth, broad convex curve extending from the blowhole region toward the rostrum.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust pixel length with a thick base extending from the cranial inflection.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Shallow, obtuse angle transition between the descending melon slope and the horizontal rostrum ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple diagonal linear scratches on the left lateral flank; small depigmented spots and pitting on the tip of the rostrum and anterior melon.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent light-colored reflective patches on the dorsal melon and along the mid-lateral body flank; clearly visible eye positioned posterior to the gape.
